import sys, time, json, copy, random
from pathlib import Path
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace','/workspace/submission']

exec(open('/workspace/tmp/test_planner.py').read().split('random.seed(10)')[0])

cases=[]
for m in range(2):
    groups=[[random.randrange(-1,g),512] for g in range(32)]

    slots=[[s*3900000000,random.randrange(1,4),0 if s==0 else random.randrange(1,3)] for s in range(256)]
    windows=[]
    for j in range(512):
        a=random.randrange(128);b=random.randrange(128,256)
        features=[[random.randrange(1501),random.randrange(2561)] for _ in range(9)]
        windows.append([random.randrange(32),slots[a][0],slots[b][0],65535,320,0,random.randrange(1,1001),features])
    cases.append({'model':['cnn','rnn'][m], 'class_values':[random.randrange(1,1001) for _ in range(7)],'stats':[1,1,10**9],'bucket':[40,40], 'slots':slots,'flows':flows,'groups':groups,'windows':windows})
request={'version':3,'cases':cases}
start=time.monotonic()
out,err,code=run(from_path,json.dumps(request).encode())
print('FULL BOUNDED:', 'exit',code,'time',time.monotonic()-start,'bytes',len(out),len(err),flush=True)
if err:print(err[:2000])
assert code==0
result=decode(out)
for c,r in zip(cases,result['results']):
    check(c,r['thresholds'],[w[6]*c['class_values'][p] for w,p in zip(c['windows'],r['predictions'])],r)
print('certificate checks passed',flush=True)
# Broad input rejection checks; malformed requests must not invoke inference.
base=copy.deepcopy(cases[0]);base['windows']=base['windows'][:1];base['slots']=[[0,1,0]];base['groups']=[];base['flows']=[[1,1,-1,0]];base['windows'][0][0]=0
base['windows'][0][1:3]=[0,0]
valid={'version':3,'cases':[base]}
invalid=[]
def bad_at(path,value):
    obj=copy.deepcopy(valid)
    at=obj
    for k in path[:-1]:at=at[k]
    at[path[-1]]=value
    invalid.append(json.dumps(obj).encode())
for path in [('version',),('cases',0,'stats',0),('cases',0,'windows',0,1),('cases',0,'windows',0,7,0,0)]:
    for value in (True,False,1.0,None,'1',-1):bad_at(path,value)
for value in ('CNN','other','',False):bad_at(('cases',0,'model'),value)
for value in ([[0,1]], [[1,1],[0,1]], [[2,1]]):bad_at(('cases',0,'groups'),value)
for value in ([[0,1,1]], [[1,1,0],[0,1,0]], [[0,0,0],[0,1,0]]):bad_at(('cases',0,'slots'),value)
for value in ([],[[0,0]]*8,[[0,0]]*10,[[1501,0]]*9,[[0,2561]]*9):bad_at(('cases',0,'windows',0,7),value)
invalid += [b'\xff',b'{}{}',b'{"version":3,"cases":[],"version":3}', b'{"version":3,"cases":[]} x',b'{"version":NaN,"cases":[]}',b'{"version":3e0,"cases":[]}',b'{"version":3,"cases":'+b'['*70+b']'*70+b'}']
# A valid first case with an invalid second must reject the whole batch.
tmp=copy.deepcopy(valid);tmp['cases'].append({'invalid':0});invalid.append(json.dumps(tmp).encode())
for i,raw in enumerate(invalid):
    out,err,code=run(from_path,raw)
    assert code==0 and json.loads(out)=={'error':'invalid'}, (i,out,err)
print('invalid bounded tests passed',len(invalid),flush=True)
# Empty selection and mixed models.
base['windows']=[]
tmp={'version':3,'cases':[base]*8}
out,err,code=run(from_path,json.dumps(tmp).encode())
assert code==0,(code,err)
for r in decode(out)['results']:check(base,[],[],r)
print('8 empty epochs passed',flush=True)
